answer: Proof of stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a digital dune that prevents infinite identity spawning. Like a ferrous material aligned within a magnetic field, identities must be anchored to financial value. This bridge between cryptoeconomics and identity ensures an attacker incurs significant capital risk, as acquiring enough stake to subvert consensus becomes prohibitively expensive compared to any potential reward gained through fraudulent nodes.
